open_points.subject: PortalStore schema creation failure
open_points.text: “Every module:portal_store transaction … begins by creating any missing table” and “a failure closes the new connection and is the storage failure” do not state whether schema functions that succeeded before a later schema failure remain persisted or are rolled back.
open_points.question: When one repository schema creation fails after earlier schema creations succeeded, must PortalStore.begin atomically roll back all schema changes, or may the earlier tables remain?
options: All schema changes from the failed begin are rolled back.
Schema changes completed before the failure may remain.
open_points.default_guess: Run the entire ordered schema-creation sequence inside the transaction and roll it back atomically on failure.

witness.initial: The SQLite database opens successfully but contains none of the repository tables.
events: A later repository schema function fails, so PortalStore.begin closes the connection and readiness returns the storage failure.
outcomes: The database still has no repository tables because the failed begin rolled back the whole schema sequence.
The tables created before the failing schema function remain, leaving a partially initialized database.
witness.observer: The host operator inspecting the database or diagnosing a later readiness/use-case attempt sees the difference.
